description:
Switching the optimizer from the default (SGD/Auto) to Adam will accelerate convergence and improve the validation metrics (mAP50 and mAP50-95) within the limited budget of 10 epochs.
Change: Explicitly set the training optimizer to 'Adam' in the model.train() call.
Previous best mAP@0.5:0.95: 0.1473
New mAP@0.5:0.95: 0.1011
Decision: REVERT
